dedupe_keys.name: covid 19 healthcare coalition capacity and ppe tools

description: The COVID-19 Healthcare Coalition's dashboard and tools were developed by MITRE and collaborators to examine hospital capacity, protective-equipment use and non-pharmaceutical interventions. The application combines R Shiny views with a Python short-term forecast model through reticulate. Inputs are public case, death, testing and other source data assembled by the supplied database-building scripts; outputs are dashboard analyses and scenario comparisons concerning capacity, PPE demand and fatalities. Coverage and temporal resolution depend on the underlying data, and updates are performed explicitly, not automatically at each launch. Source is free under Apache-2.0, with local installation instructions. A limitation is that this historical pandemic application depends on data endpoints and assumptions whose present availability and epidemiological validity were not tested. It can support reproduction of healthcare-demand and emergency-resource simulations. obflowsim (model-obflowsim) offers related hospital-flow modelling. No health records, database or running dashboard was downloaded.
